children: U.S. campus retail solutions provider's fiscal Q1 revenue grew 0.8% yr/yr
Net loss improved 29% yr/yr; adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed 19%
Company reiterated fiscal 2027 outlook and highlighted growth in First Day Complete program
Company reiterates fiscal 2027 outlook, targeting Adjusted EBITDA of $85 mln to $92 mln
Company expects about $20 mln in capital expenditures for fiscal 2027
Company anticipates further improvements in net income and additional reductions in debt
FIRST DAY PROGRAMS - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by expansion of BNC First Day programs
STORE CLOSURES - Co said exits from less profitable locations partially offset revenue gains
COMPARABLE STORE SALES - Co reported higher comparable store sales contributed to revenue growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the miscellaneous specialty retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Barnes & Noble Education Inc is $17.25, about 35.6% above its September 4 closing price of $12.72
